name: heirloom-of-materia-removes-an-opposing-champions-damage-and-returns-it-next-turn
notes: Heirloom of Materia had no implementation. Banish self, choose one (MZMODAL): mode A removes all damage from the opposing champion and records it as materiaDamage/materiaOwner counters; GAMateriaReturnDamage() (WakeUpPhase) puts it back at the beginning of the activator's next turn.

rulesClauses: Banish CARDNAME: Choose one -- Remove all damage counters from target champion you don't control. Return those counters onto that champion at the beginning of your next turn.

engineBug.summary: Heirloom of Materia's abilities were not implemented.
